verdict.rationale: Scribe's Batch mode is a documented bulk capability. It transcribes up to 10,000 audio files in one job (or 1,000 from a manifest) and can take all files under a shared S3 prefix, with glob include/exclude filters. Transcripts can be written next to each input file. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond transcription (e.g., bulk management of assets or jobs, since vocabulary endpoints are per-item), documentation of batch job monitoring and partial-failure handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
